articles.title: 米哈游养成游戏《崩坏：因缘精灵》公测定档 2027 年春季，现已开启预约
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，米哈游今日宣布精灵养成冒险策略游戏《崩坏：因缘精灵》App Store 预约现已开启，公测定档 2027 年春季。《崩坏：因缘精灵》「幸福测试」及云游戏技术测试将于 11 月 25 日正式开始，测试招募时间为 2026 年 11 月 5 日 12:00 - 2026 年 11 月 22 日 09:59。据官方介绍，玩家可通过填写招募问卷、参与官方活动等方式，抽取获得测试资格。「幸福测试」为限量、删档、计费测试，测试期间将开启付费功能，测试平台为 PC、安卓端、iOS 平台、云游戏。累计付费金额将在正式公测后，按照规则返还至测试期间进行过付费的同一米哈游通行证账号下。IT之家从官方介绍获悉，《崩坏：因缘精灵》是一款米哈游「崩坏」IP 下的全新精灵养成冒险策略游戏。在本作中，您将扮演一位从幽禁中逃生的位面旅行者，在新世界与精灵建立心与心的连接，参与一场又一场因缘对决，并发掘隐藏在自己过去的真相。

articles.title: 英伟达发布 CUDA Toolkit 13.5：正式支持 Vera Rubin，升级多 GPU 通信
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，英伟达于当地时间 11 月 4 日正式发布了最新的 CUDA Toolkit 13.5，为下一代 AI 计算平台 Vera Rubin 提供正式可用（GA）支持，标志着相关架构从早期开发者预览阶段进入面向企业生产环境的部署阶段。据英伟达官方介绍，此次更新不仅完善了 Vera Rubin 平台的底层软件支持，还针对 GPU 资源调度、多 GPU 通信、数学计算库及性能分析工具进行了多项升级，重点面向大规模 AI 训练和推理场景。在计算性能方面，CUDA 13.5 更新了 cuBLAS 的矩阵乘法启发式策略和内核调优机制，针对 Vera Rubin 架构上的 NVFP4、MXFP8 低精度矩阵运算进行了优化，覆盖混合专家模型（MoE）等训练场景。英伟达表示，这些改进能够在无需针对每种计算形状单独进行自动调优的情况下，提高训练和推理吞吐量。在 GPU 调度方面，CUDA 13.5 对 NVIDIA 多进程服务（MPS）v3 进行了升级，新增加权时间片机制。管理员可以为运行重负载的 MPS 服务器设置更长的基础计算时间片，同时独立调整 GPU 在不同任务之间的切换频率，从而更灵活地控制多任务环境下的资源分配。MPS v3 还加入了流式多处理器（SM）分区负载均衡功能。任务可以在资源充足时借用其他分区暂时闲置的 SM 资源，而当原分区需要使用这些资源时，系统会先回收已借出的部分。无论资源如何动态流转，应用看到的基础分区规模始终保持稳定。此外，新版本还增加了基于 Linux cgroup 的资源路由和命名空间级 SM 分区配置。局部域（Locality Domain）也获得了新的资源划分策略。应用现在可以选择两种 SM 分区方式：一种是在各局部域中分配相同数量的 SM，以保证资源规模的一致性和可预测性；另一种则将原本处于分区之外的补充 SM 纳入计算分区，尽可能利用 GPU 全部计算资源。开发者还可以通过相关 API 查询各分区实际获得的 SM 数量，以便合理分配计算任务。多 GPU 通信能力是此次更新的另一项重点。CUDA Tile 现在支持在计算内核内部直接访问其他 GPU 的显存，相关功能依托 NVLink 高速互连实现。借助多播指针和专用多 GPU 内存操作，开发者还可以在支持 NVLink SHARP 的 NVSwitch 网络中执行跨 GPU 数据归约和写入操作。这意味着开发者能够将 GPU 之间的数据通信与计算操作融合在同一个内核中执行，减少传统多卡协同过程中因内核边界和数据传递产生的额外开销。英伟达列举的适用场景包括融合矩阵乘法和跨 GPU 数据归约。Windows 平台方面，英伟达明确调整了 Rubin 架构的驱动模型支持范围。从 Rubin 架构开始，CUDA 不再支持 Tesla Compute Cluster（TCC）模式，仅支持 Windows Display Driver Model（WDDM）和 Microsoft Compute Driver Model（MCDM）。其中，MCDM 是面向纯计算场景的驱动模型，相关应用和部署工具需要适配新的支持范围。开发工具方面，CUDA 13.5 首次以公开预览形式推出 NVIDIA Nsight Perf SDK for AI，为长时间运行的 AI 训练和推理任务提供常开式性能分析能力。该工具能够持续收集 GPU、CPU 性能指标及执行上下文，帮助开发者定位难以复现的间歇性性能问题，并支持通过 Perfetto 查看采集结果。此外，CUDA 13.5 还更新了 CUDA Python、CUDA Graph、CCCL 3.5 等组件。其中，CUDA Python 1.2 增加批量内存复制、程序化依赖启动（PDL）以及更灵活的 CUDA Graph 更新能力；CCCL 3.5 则加入面向 CUB 的公开调优接口、批量 Top-K 选择和可重复浮点扫描等功能。驱动方面，英伟达同步发布 R620 系列数据中心 GPU 驱动，其中 Linux 版本为 620.70.06，Windows 版本为 621.14，发布日期均为 11 月 4 日。IT之家提醒，CUDA Toolkit 13.5 与数据中心驱动分别发布，驱动不再作为 Toolkit 的内置组件提供。相关阅读：《英伟达回应 Vera Rubin 平台规格变更：新版为量产规格，第三方跑分均是按量产版测的》《英伟达发布 Game Ready 621.14 驱动：优化〈魔兽世界：无限〉，修复视频黑屏问题》

articles.title: 运行近 22 年后谢幕：NASA“雨燕”天文台已坠入地球大气层，大部分部件预计烧毁
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，当地时间 11 月 4 日，美国国家航空航天局（NASA）确认尼尔 · 格雷尔斯 · 斯威夫特天文台（Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory，又称“雨燕”天文台）已于当天再入地球大气层，结束近 22 年的太空观测任务。美国太空军确认，“雨燕”天文台于美国东部时间 11 月 4 日 7 时 39 分（北京时间 11 月 4 日 20 时 39 分）在印度尼西亚北苏门答腊地区上空再入大气层，再入位置约为北纬 3.4 度、东经 98.6 度。NASA 表示，预计“雨燕”天文台的大部分部件会在穿越大气层的过程中烧毁，但仍不能排除部分部件残骸存留并落至地面的可能性。IT之家注：“雨燕”天文台于 2004 年 11 月发射升空，主要任务是探测和观测宇宙中的伽马射线暴。其最初设计的主要任务期限仅为两年，实际运行时间接近 22 年，远超最初的任务规划。NASA 介绍称，“雨燕”天文台能够观测多个波段的宇宙辐射，并快速调整观测方向，捕捉持续时间较短的宇宙爆发事件。当探测到伽马射线暴等瞬态天文现象时，它还能够向其他地面及空间观测设施发送警报，协助开展后续观测。在近 22 年的运行期间，“雨燕”天文台积累了大量观测数据，帮助科学家研究伽马射线暴及其他宇宙天体和高能天文现象，拓展了人类对宇宙中剧烈爆发现象的认识。随着运行时间不断增加，“雨燕”天文台的轨道高度持续下降。NASA 此前曾尝试通过提升轨道高度的方式延长其运行寿命，但相关努力未能成功。最终，这座运行近 22 年的天文台再入大气层，结束了太空观测任务。相关阅读：《救援尝试失败，NASA 正式终止雨燕空间望远镜任务》《NASA“雨燕”救援任务失败：LINK 航天器已坠入大气层，耗资 3000 万美元》《拯救“雨燕”空间天文台，美国宇航局成功发射 Swift Boost 任务》

articles.title: 丰田汽车 2027 财年半年报归母净利润 2.24 万亿日元，同比增长 26.1%
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，丰田汽车今日发布 2027 财年（2026 年 4 月 1 日～2027 年 3 月 31 日）半年报（2026 年 4 月 1 日～2026 年 9 月 30 日）报告：营业总收入：26.96 万亿日元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.14 万亿元人民币），同比增长 9.5%归母净利润：2.24 万亿日元（现汇率约合 944.74 亿元人民币），同比增长 26.1%基本每股收益：185.97 日元（现汇率约合 7.8 元人民币），同比增长 36.67%稀释每股收益：185.97 日元（现汇率约合 7.8 元人民币），同比增长 36.67% AI 解读本次丰田汽车 2027 财年上半年（2026 年 4 月～9 月）合并业绩，营业收入、归母净利润均超出市场分析师预期，营业利润实现六个季度以来首次同比增长。公司业务与财报亮点丰田汽车是全球最大的汽车制造商之一，核心业务包括汽车设计、制造、销售以及配套金融服务，本次披露为 2027 财年中間期（前 2 个财季累计）的合并业绩快报。营业收入达 26.96 万亿日元（现汇率约合 1.14 万亿元人民币），同比增长 9.5%；其中汽车事业营收 23.98 万亿日元（现汇率约合 1.01 万亿元人民币），金融事业营收 2.76 万亿日元（现汇率约合 1,164.06 亿元人民币）。营业利润达 2.19 万亿日元（现汇率约合 923.65 亿元人民币），同比增长 9.2%，其中汇率变动贡献 6,850 亿日元（现汇率约合 288.91 亿元人民币），销售努力贡献 1,650 亿日元（现汇率约合 69.59 亿元人民币），原价改善拖累 3,400 亿日元（现汇率约合 143.4 亿元人民币），各项经费变动拖累 200 亿日元（现汇率约合 8.44 亿元人民币），其他因素拖累 3,046 亿日元（现汇率约合 128.47 亿元人民币）。归母净利润达 2.24 万亿日元（现汇率约合 944.74 亿元人民币），同比增长 26.1%，基本每股收益 185.97 日元（现汇率约合 7.8 元人民币）。合并结算区间全球销量 475.8 万台，同比减少 0.5%，日本国内销量同比增长 5.6%，海外销量同比减少 2.1%。当期经营活动现金流净额 1.6 万亿日元（现汇率约合 674.82 亿元人民币），现金及现金等价物期末余额 9.48 万亿日元（现汇率约合 3,998.28 亿元人民币）。本次合并范围变更：日野汽车及其合并子公司共 70 家被排除在合并范围外。下财季展望与业绩修正公司对 2027 财年全年（2026 年 4 月～2027 年 3 月）业绩预测进行了修正：预计全年营业收入 53.5 万亿日元（现汇率约合 2.26 万亿元人民币），同比增长 5.6%；全年营业利润 3.9 万亿日元（现汇率约合 1,644.86 亿元人民币），同比增长 3.6%；全年归母净利润 3.57 万亿日元（现汇率约合 1,505.68 亿元人民币），同比下降 7.2%；全年每股收益预计 299.95 日元（现汇率约合 12.7 元人民币）。同时全年预计每股分红 100 日元（现汇率约合 4.2 元人民币），其中中間股息 50 日元（现汇率约合 2.1 元人民币）、期末股息 50 日元（现汇率约合 2.1 元人民币）。相关阅读： 《兰博基尼 2026 财年前三季度营收 25.3 亿欧元，同比增长约 5%》《丰田汽车 2027 财年第一财季归母净利润 1.48 万亿日元，同比增长 75.56%》风险提示：本文内容由 AI 自动分析生成，仅供参考，不代表IT之家观点。如有出入请以证监会指定上市公司信息披露平台为准。本文内容不构成投资建议，如有投资者据此操作，风险自担，IT之家对此不承担任何责任。

articles.title: Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05390v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-agent language-model systems often add a reviewer to improve an upstream agent's decision. Yet a reviewer can both repair errors and replace decisions that were already correct. We study this as a problem of institutional jurisdiction: conditional on the same proposal, task information, model, and review output, when is the reviewer authorized to make its recommendation binding? We compare broad override authority with an evidence gate that permits replacement only after the reviewer produces a mechanically valid record of a binding-constraint violation and a compliant repair. Across two locally run open-weight models, 96 spatial-policy tasks, and a 96-task portfolio-transfer benchmark, the gate sharply reduces corruption of correct proposals while retaining most repairs of violations. articles.title: Agent Harness Awareness: Turning Verified Telemetry into Operational Control for Tool-Using Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05391v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Tool descriptions tell an agent what an action can do, but they do not necessarily reveal whether that action is healthy or suitable at the moment of use. Execution harnesses often possess this information through monitors, traces, and recent failures while the model choosing the next action does not. We call this gap operational blindness. We introduce Agent Harness Awareness, a trust-separated design in which the host supplies a small, fresh, verified state snapshot before a consequential action while retaining measurement, enforcement, evaluation, and final dispatch authority. We test its tools-and-network instance with ToolRoute, a controlled isolation benchmark that holds the task and candidate semantics constant and varies the operational information available to the model. In a 216-decision ablation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash, verified tool-health state reduced mean observable policy regret by 96.9%

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Resource Orchestration for Agentic AI Systems
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05392v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems powered by large language models (LLMs) execute as autonomous multi-step pipelines that dynamically invoke tools, integrate observations into memory, and iterate until a task is resolved or a resource budget is exhausted. Unlike classical workflows with fixed graphs, the aggregate compute, bandwidth, and end-to-end latency demands of such pipelines are unknown at dispatch time: they emerge at runtime from intermediate observations and stochastic token sampling, yielding heavy-tailed, multi-modal random variables. This unpredictability forces infrastructure orchestrators into a dilemma: under-provisioning risks mid-execution throttling and deadline violations, while over-provisioning wastes scarce edge or cloud capacity. Abstract: Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. Abstract: Tiered inference distributes large language model computation across a hierarchy of devices, from on-device and edge hardware to the datacenter, and is increasingly offered as the route to cheaper, lower-latency, and more private serving. Abstract: We evaluate the extent to which agentic AI models can complete an end-to-end data science project, and how this improves with feedback. Of the 147 initial submissions, 107 run and render, and the average score increases from 59 per cent to 76 per cent after the final round of feedback. articles.content:

Abstract: Transparency has become a central principle in AI governance, yet there is little agreement about what transparency means, for whom, and in what contexts. Drawing on interpretive flexibility within the Social Construction of Technology, this paper examines how different stakeholders understand and experience transparency in generative AI. This study draws from a global survey of 400 end-users, AI builders, and policymakers, complemented by a structured focus group with end-users, grounding the quantitative findings in qualitative insights from the group most underserved by current transparency practice. articles.title: AGORA: Reliability-Aware Aggregation of LLM Judges via Item-Response Theory
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05556v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge is a common substitute for costly human evaluation, and aggregating several judges is the standard remedy for any single judge's bias. Judge pools mix judges of very different reliability, while the human-labeled sets that validate them hold a few hundred items or fewer. In this regime the per-item mean weights weak judges as heavily as strong ones, and confusion-table models such as Dawid-Skene must estimate a per-judge error table from too few items. We propose AGORA (Aggregation Of Reliability-weighted Assessments), an item-response-theory aggregator that places every item on one latent quality scale and describes each judge by a sensitivity parameter and ordered rating thresholds, so judge reliability is learned from all items jointly and without human labels. Abstract: Real-world vision is dynamic and scene-rich, while EEG and fMRI resolve it at complementary temporal and spatial scales. Most neural decoding systems, however, align one modality in isolation and mostly against static images or short clips. Abstract: As autonomous AI agents enter permissionless onchain markets, selecting new service providers remains a core challenge. Abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) speeds up large language model (LLM) serving, but its gain depends on the workload's \emph{shape}, such as batch size and context length, and on its \emph{content}. A model-based drafter proposes a short block on any content, while a model-free drafter such as n-gram lookup proposes long copies at almost no cost when the output repeats its input, as in code editing. Adaptive verification spends a batch-wide verification budget on the draft tokens most likely to be accepted, but it supports only one model-based drafter. articles.content:

Abstract: On Replit, our agentic engineering platform, users now build entire products without writing code, through successive feature requests to an agent. Yet existing coding benchmarks evaluate single, fully specified tasks, and many are near saturation. Abstract: Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. However, these eigensystems must retain the structural properties of graph Laplacians. Existing approaches preserve eigenvector orthonormality but do not enforce the Laplacian nullspace constraint, potentially producing eigensystems inconsistent with Laplacian structure. To address this, we introduce Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching (LaSFM), which preserves the nullspace condition alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues during generation. Abstract: High-fidelity simulation of dynamical systems is central to scientific discovery and engineering design, yet remains computationally demanding. articles.title: Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05506v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with several objectives, such as helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty, typically relies on preference judgment for each objective, growing the annotation cost linearly with the number of objectives. Active preference learning can reduce this cost by selecting the comparisons whose labels are expected to change the policy most. Existing remedies either lack an objective-aware query selection mechanism for the multi-objective setting or regard conflicting preferences as harmful, therefore excluding them from the training data. We introduce OGC-DPO (Objective-conditioned Gradient Coverage DPO), an active learning framework that treats each (response pair, objective) combination as a separate query and measures its informativeness through the policy's own implicit gradient, without relying on an external reward model. OGC-DPO then selects the queries that most expand each objective's gradient coverage.

Abstract: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Abstract: Support vector machines (SVMs) are fundamentally grounded in geometric margin maximisation and currently lack a mainstream probabilistic interpretation. Abstract: Data tends to be most useful when it is shared, and the data most worth sharing is often the data that privacy obligations restrict. Synthetic data from a generator trained under differential privacy (DP) is one way to reconcile the two, but its utility depends on the privacy budget $\varepsilon$ and on how much data the generator sees - a parameter that most data sharing applications of synthetic data control. We present SAVANT, a self-attentive variational autoencoder for tabular data trained with DP-SGD that, to our knowledge, is the first to combine attention, a VAE, and DP in one tabular model. We evaluate it against two marginal mechanisms, PrivBayes and MST, jointly over the privacy budget and the dataset size on two public datasets, measuring the utility a downstream classifier loses by training on synthetic rather than real data. Abstract: Reasoning-oriented language model training increasingly relies on multiple on-policy rollouts, but standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) uses a fixed group size, wasting compute on easy prompts and under-exploring hard ones. Abstract: Relevance propagation, which redistributes a network's prediction backward through the layers, is usually treated as a heuristic. Abstract: A deep RL agent trained on a fixed persona reward plays one way: an Explorer keeps exploring while starving, a Survivor hoards on an empty map. Abstract: Variational approaches to learning transport maps for multimodal sampling can suffer from mode collapse. Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) to consolidate capabilities from multiple teachers. arXiv:2611.05616v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Training on large datasets motivates selecting which examples receive expensive training computation. Fixed quotas determine the amount of pruning in advance, while absolute confidence cutoffs depend on the score scale. We study a population-relative alternative that adapts the threshold and retained count together. We introduce LACS (Label-Agnostic Confidence Selector), a training-time rule based on maximum predictive confidence, requiring neither labels at selection time nor per-example gradients. For $0<\rho<1$, the removed fraction is at most $\rho$ and at least one example remains. The unsigned score permits both confidently correct and confidently wrong examples to be removed. Abstract: Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Abstract: A central challenge in assistive brain-to-robot control is decoding a user's latent intent from complex and noisy brain signals. Prior approaches evaluate decoders as single-trial classifiers with accuracy-based metrics, but this neglects the inherently sequential nature of assistive control. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05382v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Misinformation spreads faster than professional fact-checkers can manually verify it and write articles explaining their verdicts. This creates a need to automate the production of fact-checking articles. This paper details work done by the DS@GT ARC team for CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3 Fact-Checking Article Generation. We seek to generate a full fact-checking article from a claim, its original verdict, and a set of scraped source documents. Our team built a four-stage pipeline that cleans noisy evidence, retrieves and clusters relevant sources, generates the article by conditioning \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} on the original fact-checker verdict, and recovers inline citations through deterministic post-processing. We achieved a mean score of 0.428 and ranked 3rd out of 9 teams for the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3, compared to a baseline mean score of 0.272. Abstract: Generalisability is a central question for deep neural networks, including the cross-language generalisation of speaker embeddings. Abstract: LLMs can repair noisy OCR transcripts of historical documents, but they also change text that was already correct. We propose EditVeto, a veto gate placed after a full-context LLM rewrite. Abstract: Different retrievers exist for retrieval-augmented generation, yet none performs best for all queries. Therefore, the key question is: given a query and retrieved passages from different retrievers, which one is most suited for that query? Existing routers usually make predictions from query-specific features and a fixed pool of retrievers; such routers have no output for an unseen retriever and are incapable by design on a new corpus. To fill these gaps, RAGCompass reads the retrieved passage sets themselves: passages from an unfamiliar retriever or corpus stay directly comparable to other passages, so routing stays well designed where a query-only map would fail. articles.content:

Abstract: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Abstract: How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? Abstract: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation: given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value, which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD), which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05827v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Decision models choose among predefined options in tasks such as routing and action selection. In multi-agent collaboration, a decision determines how members divide work, exchange resources, and act in parallel. We introduce TandemBench, a benchmark of 1,200 questions in multi-agent cooking scenarios where coordination choices affect goal completion. Models receive complete global information and candidate team plans, with reference answers established through execution and exact search. Models select an optimal team plan and, in paired variants that retain or remove it, judge whether better arrangements exist beyond the supplied options. We evaluate 40 native decision models and compare them with 10 general-purpose language models. The best native decision model achieves 62.50% decision accuracy. Abstract: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. However, reliable evaluation faces Data scarcity and Difficulty Standardizing Criteria. To address these obstacles, we introduce CARTBench for CART (Complex and Ambiguous Requests with Timelines). For Data scarcity, we curate cases from real commercial shopping needs across 17 retail domains, pairing timestamped dialogue with 1,603 product records. For Difficulty Standardizing Criteria, we develop case-specific rubrics guided by Ideal Response Principles, distilled from excellent replies manually selected from successfully completed orders. These principles also guide Principle-Guided CART Prompting, our structured recommendation strategy. Abstract: Confidence estimates guide human review in LLM-built knowledge graphs, but better error prediction can yield little improvement in an audit. articles.content:

Abstract: Visual autoregressive generation spans two dominant paradigms: next-scale prediction for images and video, and next-frame prediction for video. Both decode block-by-block rather than token-by-token, yielding KV caches whose statistics diverge from those of language models. At scale, KV memory exceeds the weights and limits large-scale deployment caused by a large amount of visual tokens. Our analysis of these caches reveals three findings. First, a small set of massive-value channels carries the functional load: ablating these outlier channels collapses generation, whereas ablating a matched set of inlier channels leaves quality intact. Second, the outliers organize along two axes, feature and block, with magnitudes persistent within each cell and shifting across cells. Abstract: In Bangladesh, much localized misinformation spreads as photocards: single-image news summaries that imitate the branding of well-known news organizations. Because the misleading message lives in the pixels rather than in machine-readable text, text-based fact-checking tools cannot see it. We recast photocard fake-news detection as visual image forgery detection. We build a dataset of 969 authentic and 1,077 fabricated Bangla photocards scraped from public Facebook pages: authentic cards from the verified pages of seventeen national television broadcasters, fabricated ones from pseudo-broadcaster pages, anonymous profiles, and public groups. Sixteen photometric and morphological transformations per image grow the corpus to 32,736 samples. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05404v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The hand localization problem has been a longstanding focus due to its many applications. The task involves modeling the hand as a singular point and determining its position within a defined coordinate system. However, due to data modality limitations, existing hand localization technologies face several challenges. For example, vision-based localization raises privacy concerns, while wearable-based methods compromise user comfort. In this paper, we introduce mmHand, a new device-free, privacy-preserving dynamic hand localization system with pixel-level accuracy, using a single commodity mmWave device. We first propose a mmImage generation tool to fully extract spatial information from raw mmWave data and introduce a novel 2D image-format representation of mmWave data. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05406v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Contrastive pretraining has advanced image-text understanding, yet image, video, and audio encoders are still trained independently, with cross-modal alignment realized mainly through post-hoc binding to a frozen anchor space. We present Omni-Encoder, a general multimodal encoder that processes image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs within a single SigLIP-2 Vision Transformer with fully shared parameters. Unlike anchor-centric binding or per-modality adapters, all modalities are optimized jointly end-to-end, and the framework is organized from input to training. A modality-native input stage first maps each signal into the shared embedding space, including a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer that converts mel-spectrograms into tokens aligned with visual patches. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05407v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diffusion image generators are successful due to accurate denoising networks and strong numerical samplers. Yet the two components are not fully matched. During sampling, the denoiser predicts for the next step based on flawed input that differ much from the real data. This train-test gap, or exposure bias, caps image generation quality (i.e., blurry, lacking in details or awkward in shape). To mitigate the problem, we propose PEEK, a novel training-free deterministic sampler plugin. At each eligible denoising step, PEEK first performs a provisional one-step update, evaluates the denoiser once at the look-ahead state, and interpolates it with the one-step-later prediction to form the next noisy state. By taking the additional step, we obtain a generally more-image-like prediction from the higher-signal noisy state, mitigating the exposure bias. Abstract: Low-textured sketch images are widely used in scientific applications, including wildlife conservation, archaeological illustration, and forensic composites. Learning from and retrieving such images is challenging because they lack detailed surface textures and visual variations commonly exploited by modern deep learning models. This paper proposes Augmentation with Reinforcement Transformation (ART) to fine-tune pretrained models to learn effective representations for accurate sketch image retrieval. Our key observation is that sketches are particularly sensitive to image transformations, such as rotation, flipping, zooming, and stretching. articles.content:

Abstract: Point cloud denoising aims to recover clean geometry from noisy 3D observations while preserving both fine surface details and the underlying spatial distribution of the points. Many learning-based methods adopt a two-stage pipeline that first extracts point-wise features from the noisy input and subsequently predicts point-wise displacements via simple regressions. However, these approaches often lack robust feature guidance and distribution-aware geometric refinement, causing them to fail at maintaining optimal point uniformity and geometric quality. To address these limitations, we propose PointNDF, a denoising framework that combines patch-level geometric context with local displacement prediction. Abstract: Surgical world models have the potential to provide intra-operative guidance, accelerate risk-free training and facilitate transfer of expert surgical maneuvers. However, the use of world models for transferring surgical expertise has been largely unexplored. Moreover, recent approaches in this domain have mainly relied on ground truth kinematics actions or expert annotations for specific tasks, limiting their applicability beyond the narrow range of tasks with ground-truth annotations. In contrast, existing works in the natural domain have shown promising results in learning latent actions solely from unlabeled videos and transferring the learned actions across contexts. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05449v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Learning on boundary representations (B-reps) requires robustness to the pose of a part, since CAD models are not stored in a canonical orientation. Existing B-rep networks either operate on world-frame coordinates and normals, and thus degrade under rotation, or encode each face in a local reference frame. Local frames yield invariance, but reduce inter-face messages to scalars and discard the relative orientation of adjacent faces. We propose SO3brep, an SO(3)-equivariant graph neural network on the B-rep face-adjacency graph. Node features are computed in local frames and mapped into a shared frame by Wigner D-matrices. Clebsch-Gordan tensor products couple these features with the directions between adjacent faces, so that relative orientation is preserved throughout message passing and the output remains SE(3)-invariant. articles.title: From Tokens to Trajectories: Parameter-Efficient Continuous Adaptation of Unified Multimodal Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05451v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: While discrete tokenization in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) establishes strong semantic reasoning, it introduces a strict quantization bottleneck that degrades fine-grained visual details, often resulting in structurally accurate but artifact-heavy images. We introduce FlowShift, a parameter-efficient post-training framework that bypasses this bottleneck by converting pre-trained discrete UMMs into continuous rectified-flow generators. Instead of discarding the backbone's semantic priors, FlowShift replaces discrete visual interfaces with continuous latent projections and applies LoRA to the attention layers. To efficiently boost visual quality without semantic drift, we propose Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD), which aligns the model with a high-fidelity continuous teacher and ground-truth continuous trajectories. This approach drastically improves perceptual quality while preserving prompt adherence and reasoning.

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose visual representations into individual features, offering a promising basis for explaining model behavior. Interpreting these features typically relies on images or pixel regions that most strongly activate them. However, this evidence becomes ambiguous when multiple features with different semantics frequently activate in the same locations, such as texture and color in the same patterns. We propose Reconstructive SAE Intervention (RecSAEI), a framework that shifts feature explanation from passive observation to active visual reconstruction. By intervening on representations along SAE decoder directions and reconstructing the visual output, we provide direct evidence of a feature's semantic meaning. We demonstrate that our method successfully disambiguates feature meanings across multiple datasets and vision encoders. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05559v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models score left/right relations near chance, but the symptom has two causes that call for opposite repairs: the relation may survive in the pooled embedding yet be unreachable by native image-text similarity, or pooling may discard it while the dense features retain it. While the state-of-the-art rely on training models for explicit modeling of uncertainty, there is a gap in exploring different roles that estimated uncertainty using generative approaches can play. Given a pre-change image and partial post-change evidence, ChangeJEPA predicts the full post-change representation under two complementary conditions: a prior hypothesis derived from the pre-change scene and an updated hypothesis conditioned on observed post-change context. Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) systems serve users across languages and cultural contexts. We find that value-neutral prompts, which admit diverse cultural interpretations, nonetheless yield images that favor particular value orientations, a phenomenon we call visual value leakage. articles.title: GaussianRenderFormer: Transformer-based Rendering of 3D Gaussian Splats
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05593v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Can a neural network learn to render 3D Gaussian splats on its own, with no rasterizer in the renderer? We present GaussianRenderFormer, a transformer that takes a set of Gaussians and a camera and outputs the image directly. Each Gaussian becomes one token in a view-independent encoder, and a view-dependent decoder turns small patches of camera rays into pixels by attending to those tokens. Trained on 26,820 Objaverse objects pruned to 20,000 Gaussians each, GaussianRenderFormer renders 300 unseen objects at 38.08 dB PSNR against the full, unpruned splats, while rasterizing the same pruned input reaches 44.02 dB. The gap is not one of generalization, and our diagnostics are consistent with a bottleneck in the view decoder: telling it the projected footprint of each Gaussian, which it could in principle infer, adds 1.4 dB. articles.title: CAPTOR: text-encoder-free grounding by counting caption co-occurrence over the visual words of a frozen encoder
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05599v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Grounding a text query in an image needs a matrix scoring every term against every patch. Vision-language models compute it with an aligned text encoder, which many image encoders, such as histopathology-related models trained on slides alone, lack. The Caption-Anchored Patch-Term Occurrence Representation (CAPTOR) estimates the matrix without a text encoder. It clusters a frozen image encoder's patch tokens into visual words and describes each captioned image by its share of patches in each word. A term signature is the standardized difference of those shares between images whose captions mention the term and the rest. The matrix factorizes into a term-by-word table and a query-independent image factor, so an image is encoded once and a new term adds one table row. articles.content:

Abstract: Large language models understand passengers' driving commands, but as driving agents they reason in generated text for seconds and must infer each action's consequences implicitly from the scene. We present Jev-AD, which pairs Jev, a typed decision model that answers predefined questions with probabilities, not generated text, with a language world model that predicts for every candidate action how nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds. Code turns these predictions into foreseen consequences, which Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates. In simulated highway merging (500 car-episodes), this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, and Jev-AD achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of free-form command trials. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05507v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Humanoid motion tracking has scaled to general policies that reproduce diverse human motion, but the resulting behavior is in free-space: the tracker knows where the body should be, not how it should interact with the environment. Other work makes the object part of the objective, yet abstracts that interaction to contact or geometry, which leaves the demanding cases under-explored. We argue that force is a natural command channel between motion imitation and object interaction, one that specifies not just where to make contact but how hard. We present Ctrl-F, a hierarchical motion-force framework that augments motion tracking with an explicit force command, a 3-D force at each designated contact body such as a hand or a foot. articles.title: MESA: An Evaluation Framework for Compositional, Semantic, and Spatial Generalization in Robotics
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05567v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Despite growing interest in foundation models for robotic manipulation, systematic evaluation of their capabilities remains elusive. Existing benchmarks are either narrow and saturated, offering little signal on SOTA methods, broadly scoped, providing diversity at the cost of controlled experimentation, or require training on large, messy open-source datasets. We introduce MESA, an evaluation framework designed for precise, reproducible measurement of language-conditioned policy generalization. MESA provides five evaluation suites that isolate in-distribution performance and four distinct axes of generalization: spatial configuration, object instance, object category, and subtask composition, enabling researchers to diagnose where and why policies fail, not just whether they fail. articles.title: ELA: End-to-End Latent Action Policy Learning from Video Demonstrations
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05571v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robot imitation learning is limited by the scarcity of action-labeled data, while action-free demonstrations such as videos are abundant. Recent latent-action methods learn action-relevant representations from observation transitions, but they do not optimize latent actions for downstream control, leading to latent representations that are difficult for policies to model and difficult to accurately decode into continuous robot actions. This paper introduces ELA, an end-to-end framework for learning from video demonstrations via latent actions jointly optimized for policy learning and action decoding. ELA jointly trains a latent action model, latent action policy, and action decoder, enabling policies to leverage abundant video data with only a handful of action-labeled robot demonstrations. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05585v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This letter presents a trajectory planner for humanoid robots to perform dynamic motions on complex, parameterizable terrains using a contact-implicit whole-body optimization framework. The planner generates feasible movements without predefined contact sequences, considering the robot's full dynamics and kinematics. To plan bipedal locomotion on steps, ramps, and other terrains, we propose a mathematical model to approximate ground geometry with a smooth surface. The rigid interaction between the robot and the ground is modeled via novel contact constraints, extending the domain of applicability from flat and horizontal surfaces to any arbitrary smooth surface. Effectiveness is demonstrated using nonlinear programming to plan motions on various terrain topologies. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05615v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: High motion performance and avoiding structural vibrations rely on smooth trajectory planning. The smoothness requirement depends on the robot's complexity in terms of the number of degrees of freedom and system order due to the flexibility of the joints and links. For industrial robots, the smoothness requirements have been determined and subsequently taken into account. Although unknown for soft continuum robots, the exact smoothness requirement can potentially be much larger than previously considered ones such as $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^4}$ for collaborative robots and $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^5}$ for quadcopter drones. To address this gap, we introduce a $\mathbf{\mathcal{C}^\infty}$-smooth trajectory generator that respects defined kinematic limits and generates infinitely differentiable trajectories. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05667v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper presents Proactive Human-in-the-Loop (PHIL), a framework for proactive policy correction and preference-based post-training. PHIL enables operators to preview policy-predicted future motion and intervene before anticipated undesirable actions. During takeover, PHIL continues querying the policy and displaying its predicted trajectories in the physical workspace through an extended reality (XR) interface. PHIL pairs rejected policy predictions with corrective action chunks subsequently executed from the same physical state over the same horizon, and preference-based post-training encourages the policy to favor these corrections. This paper evaluates PHIL on four real-world manipulation tasks using a diffusion policy and a pretrained vision-language-action policy. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05738v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05741v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Motor responses evoked by noxious stimulation are used to assess neurological function in hospitalized patients with disorders of consciousness. In standard bedside assessments, these stimuli are applied manually, resulting in substantial variation in force, duration, frequency, and location. Here, we present OUCH (Objective, Uniform, Controlled Haptic stimulation), a wrist-worn device that uses pneumatic actuation to deliver noxious mechanical stimuli. OUCH combines stacked pneumatic pouch actuators, a rigid indenter, and a compliant spacer designed to buckle at a set load, so that the indenter contacts the skin only during actuation. articles.content:

Abstract: We study physics-based retargeting of human demonstrations for robot learning: finding robot controls that reproduce reference motions under contact dynamics. We propose GRASP (Gradient Recovery from Archived Samples for Proposals), which combines sampling-based exploration with gradient-guided refinement without requiring a differentiable simulator. GRASP-TO extends tempered sequential Monte Carlo by fitting local quadratic cost models to archived rollouts and using their gradients to guide Markov chain Monte Carlo rejuvenation. Metropolis-Hastings correction preserves the target distribution for each fixed proposal kernel, and a population analysis connects the recovered gradients to Gaussian smoothing. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05793v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Short-horizon model predictive control (MPC) is fast but myopic. ZipMPC compensates by learning a context-dependent correction of the short-horizon cost that imitates a long-horizon expert. We observe that the optimal correction is often multimodal: when a slower opponent can be passed on either side, good corrections of opposite sign coexist, and the expert's choice between them hinges on tiny cost differences. Deterministic regression then averages modes or inherits inconsistent expert tie-breaking. We propose ZipDrift, which trains a one-step drifting generator over MPC cost corrections, tilted toward low closed-loop cost and learned only from cost evaluations of candidate corrections, without differentiating through the optimiser. A few generated candidates are ranked by a learned critic, and the model-based MPC then enforces dynamics and constraints. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05838v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Assessing the deployment performance of learned robot policies during training is challenging, as directly measuring task success requires costly real-world trials for each candidate checkpoint. Averaged validation loss offers a rollout-free alternative, but its checkpoint rankings can be inconsistent with deployment performance. We analyze two limitations of this criterion: it penalizes action deviations without considering whether the policy can recover from them, and gives later reference predictions equal weight even when earlier deviations may lead execution away from the reference. We propose RACE, a novel rollout-free metric for ranking checkpoints using a fixed set of held-out successful trajectories. Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) support planning by comparing predicted latent states with an encoded goal. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05885v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The optimal rapidly exploring random tree (RRT*) is proven asymptotically optimal on open subsets of Euclidean space with straight-line local planning. We ask whether it works on a triangle-mesh terrain, a two-dimensional surface in R^3. First, the original RRT* cannot run on a mesh: the surface has zero volume, so uniform sampling never hits it, no clearance ball fits in it, and chords across a fold leave it. Second, the surface reformulation we call Mesh RRT*, with its naive edge, the chord costed by its length, solved every run on heightfields with slopes up to 75 degrees but minimises the wrong objective: its cost, the straight-line length of a polyline whose vertices lie on the surface while its segments may leave it by a tolerance tau, is the length of no route on the surface and lies strictly below the geodesic length on any curved mesh. arXiv:2611.05897v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An ordered sequence of end-effector poses can give a redundant robot arm multiple valid joint configurations at each waypoint. Inverse kinematics (IK) computes these configurations. Choosing a configuration only for the next waypoint can leave the arm poorly placed for later waypoints. This may increase planned motion time or cause a later planning failure. This paper presents Future-Window Inverse Kinematics (FWIK), an online method that selects IK solutions by considering a small window of future waypoints. FWIK generates several IK candidates, connects them in a layered joint-space graph, and ranks candidate paths with a simple motion-time estimate. A learned model removes paths whose transitions are likely to cause self-collision. Abstract: Off-policy deep reinforcement learning trains on random samples from a replay buffer of past experience. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05936v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Integrating six-axis tactile feedback into robotic interfaces requires compact sensors with accurate load measurement and rapid online reconstruction. This paper presents LumiTac, a low-profile, camera-free optoelectronic tactile sensor combining spatially distributed illumination with spectral encoding. Five photoemitters and five RGBW photoreceivers are mounted on opposing circuit boards coupled through translucent silicone. Load-induced interlayer motion modulates the internal light field under compression, shear, bending, and torsion. The sensing head measures 12 mm in diameter and 4.75 mm in thickness, weighs less than 2 g, and has a component cost of approximately USD 7. A compact multilayer perceptron reconstructs three force and three moment components from 20 optical channels. arXiv:2611.05938v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Visual-inertial odometry relies on visual features that correspond to 3D points with consistent projections across sequential frames. In reflective indoor-floor environments, however, specular floor patterns can be detected and triangulated as virtual features below the physical ground plane, producing unreliable feature associations and inconsistent visual residuals. This paper proposes a lightweight reflection-aware front-end for feature-based stereo VIO. Rather than suppressing all floor-region features, the proposed method estimates the ground height in real time and rejects only feature candidates whose inferred 3D positions are below the estimated ground height. articles.title: Learning Object-Centric Motion Priors from Human for Robotic Dexterous Manipulation
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.05979v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Manipulating diverse objects with multi-fingered dexterous hands is challenging due to the high dimensionality and complex dynamics. Human-Object Interaction (HOI) datasets provide rich knowledge about task information and embodied interactions. Instead of solely imitating the human demonstrations, our method learns to holistically predict future hand-object states by leveraging these datasets. The predicted future states of the object can serve as a general-purpose reward term for reinforcement learning, reducing reliance on task-specific reward engineering and enhancing generalization across tasks. We conduct extensive experiments on three manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world. Our approach outperforms existing SOTA methods in both success rate and generalizability on novel objects. Furthermore, we validate the cross-embodiment compatibility of our methods by successfully deploying the skills on different robot hands.

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，世界互联网大会乌镇峰会互联网企业家论坛于 11 月 4 日在浙江乌镇举行。微博 CEO 王高飞出席论坛并发表题为“共建可信企业 IP，让中国企业家的声音走向世界”的主旨演讲。据新浪科技报道，王高飞表示，企业家日益成为品牌对外叙事的重要主体。中国产品走向世界，企业家的声音也要形成传播合力。企业家 IP 不只是个人流量热度，更是通过技术分享、产品理念、责任担当形成的长期信任资产。针对企业家如何做好公众沟通，王高飞指出，企业家运营个人 IP 尤其需要警惕三种常见误区：只有宣传，没有沟通；只有道理，没有共情；只有态度，没有行动。用户关注企业家，不只是看产品，更希望得到真实解释、互动反馈和被尊重的感受；企业家发声既要向外解释战略，也要向内感知用户问题。围绕网络营商环境与平台责任，王高飞介绍，近年来在中央网信办的指导下，微博把保护企业家权益上升到平台战略：一方面开通投诉专区，优化“一键防护”工具，帮助企业家隔离恶意攻击；另一方面，主动处置贬损丑化企业家的不良内容，斩断恶意营销炒作的灰色链条。今年以来，微博平台累计清理涉企违规信息 11 万余条，处置账号 1200 余个。据IT之家今年 9 月报道，中央网信办发布通知，处置涉企侵权信息，事关企业、企业家切身利益，事关人民群众切身权益。经过一段时间实践，各方对处置涉企侵权信息已形成共识。网站平台对以下涉企侵权信息，应当积极主动清理处置。1.个人信息类。包括泄露企业家身份证、护照、户籍档案、家庭住址、电话号码等个人身份及联系信息，以及生物识别、医疗健康、金融账户、行踪轨迹等敏感个人信息。2.侮辱贬损类。包括侮辱谩骂企业、企业家，恶搞丑化企业标识、产品和企业家肖像，将企业、企业家与色情低俗话题恶意关联，使用污名化词汇诋毁企业、企业家或特定品牌用户。3.假冒仿冒类。包括假冒仿冒新闻单位制作发布的涉企监督信息，假借企业或企业家名义发布的信息，在公众账号名称、头像、简介中，擅自使用与企业相同或相似的名称标识或企业家姓名肖像。4.虚假误导类。包括断章取义、歪曲解读企业家过往言论，呈现与事实不符的搜索关键词联想、搜索落地页结果，已经权威辟谣、澄清的不实信息，与企业、企业家在超大平台上的官方账号发布的公开声明不符信息。5.其他类。包括涉企拉踩引战信息，集纳翻炒的企业旧闻旧事、负面信息，已被本平台处置过的涉企侵权信息，机器人账号、网络水军账号发布的涉企评论信息，明显违背公序良俗抹黑诋毁企业、企业家信息。

articles.title: 特斯拉美国 FSD 再陷致命事故：71 岁男子横穿高速被撞身亡，车速约 113km/h
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，美国加州瓦列霍市一条高速公路 10 月下旬发生了一起致命交通事故，一名 71 岁男子横穿高速公路时，被一辆特斯拉汽车撞击身亡。特斯拉驾驶员向警方表示，车辆当时已经开启 FSD 驾驶。加州公路巡警（CHP）调取车辆行车记录仪后发现，车辆曾尝试刹车并向左转向避让，但最终未能避免碰撞。据美国哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS News）报道，此次事故发生于当地时间 10 月 22 日凌晨 2 时 35 分左右，地点位于加州瓦列霍市 I-80 州际公路西行方向、I-780 互通立交附近。涉事特斯拉汽车由一名 26 岁的旧金山男子驾驶。警方表示，驾驶员事发后留在现场配合调查，并主动向警方提供了车辆行车记录仪拍摄的视频。根据加州公路巡警对视频的初步审查，事故发生时，特斯拉以约 70 英里 / 小时（IT之家注：约 113 公里 / 小时）的速度行驶在高速公路第二车道。一名 71 岁男子从高速公路右侧路肩进入主路，随后朝中央隔离带方向横穿车道，直接进入特斯拉的行驶路径。视频显示，特斯拉在行人进入行驶路径后开始制动，同时向左转向，试图避开行人。不过，加州公路巡警表示，尽管车辆采取了上述避让措施，特斯拉右前部最终还是撞上了这名男子。事故发生后，男子倒在高速公路行车道内，随后又遭到至少一辆过往车辆撞击。加州公路巡警表示，没有其他涉事车辆在现场停车，警方目前尚未掌握后续涉事车辆及驾驶员的身份信息。根据美国《旧金山纪事报》及当地媒体后续报道，索拉诺县法医办公室确认，死者名为 Domingo Gonzales，是一名 71 岁的瓦列霍居民。目前，特斯拉驾驶员尚未因这起事故被开具交通罚单。不过，加州公路巡警发言人 Scott Heitman 向《旧金山纪事报》表示，如果后续调查认定驾驶员存在导致事故发生的过失行为，检方仍可能提起相关指控。需要注意的是，目前关于 FSD 状态的信息主要来自驾驶员向警方作出的陈述，加州公路巡警尚未公布车辆后台数据核查结果，也没有最终认定事故责任。行车记录仪视频显示的制动和转向动作，也不能单独证明车辆系统已经正确识别所有风险或完成了有效避让。加州公路巡警此前强调，特斯拉 FSD 并不意味着车辆可以完全自主驾驶，驾驶员仍须承担车辆安全操作责任。目前，瓦列霍这起致死事故仍在调查中，警方也呼吁掌握后续涉事车辆线索的目击者主动提供信息。

articles.title: 索尼 Xperia 10 VIII/10 VII 手机推送 Android 17 更新，无缘安卓 iOS 文件互传功能
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，科技媒体 Android Authority 昨日（11 月 4 日）发布博文，报道称索尼已面向 Xperia 10 VIII 与 Xperia 10 VII 推送安卓 17 更新，但上述两款手机无法完整体验安卓 17 的全部新功能。IT之家附上相关截图如下：根据官方声明，Xperia 10 VIII 与 Xperia 10 VII 两款手机升级安卓 17 后，在个性化界面上有所升级。本次更新扩展“壁纸和样式”功能，带来新的壁纸与时钟设计，并支持用户自定义图标的形状和样式。新版改进快速设置面板，用户可调整图块大小与排列方式，较大的图块还能显示简短说明。本次安卓 17 更新还增强屏幕录制功能，用户可选择录制整个屏幕或仅录制当前应用，还能同时录制设备内部声音与麦克风声音，对需要制作教程、演示或游戏视频的用户更为友好。在功能限制方面，Xperia 10 VIII 和 VII 将无法使用 Quick Share 的跨平台互联支持，也无法获得升级版 AI 相机助手，且无法体验安卓 17 的桌面模式。另外值得注意的是，索尼此前曾表示 Xperia 10 VI 会适配安卓 17，但在 10 月改变了计划。索尼称，由于该机型“存储配置方面的限制”，最终决定不向 Xperia 10 VI 提供此次更新。

articles.title: 暴力熊 Thermal Grizzly 发布 PhaseSheet PTM Pro：导热更强、安装更省心
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，德国散热品牌 Thermal Grizzly（国内俗称暴力熊）宣布推出新一代相变导热垫 PhaseSheet PTM Pro，在保持相变导热垫易用特性的同时，提升了导热性能，并重点改进了载体膜结构，让装机过程更顺手。IT之家注：相变导热垫是一种介于传统导热硅脂和普通导热垫之间的散热界面材料。它在常温下是柔软的固体片材，方便直接贴在 CPU / GPU 表面；当芯片运行升温后，材料会“相变”软化，更好地填满芯片顶盖与散热器之间的细微空隙，从而降低热阻、提升散热效率。相比涂抹硅脂，它更适合追求整洁、可重复安装和低失误率的 DIY 用户。PhaseSheet PTM Pro 的核心升级之一是提升导热系数，官方表示通过优化材料配方，可带来更好的散热表现，尤其适合高功耗 CPU、紧凑型主机以及需要长期稳定运行的整机。另一项升级是改进是重新设计载体膜。过去相变垫两侧的保护膜在撕除时容易粘连、拉扯甚至撕裂材料，造成边缘破损或浪费。新款载体膜据称更容易从两侧剥离，降低安装时损坏导热垫的风险，对第一次使用相变垫的用户尤其友好。售价方面，在 Thermal Grizzly 官网显示规格为 40*40 毫米，售价为 23.28 美元（现汇率约合 155.6 元人民币）。

articles.title: 抢先《燕云十六声》，网易《永劫无间》正式支持英伟达 DLSS 5 技术成为首款实装的国产游戏
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，在没有任何预告的情况下，网易《永劫无间》官方刚刚宣布已正式支持英伟达 DLSS 5 技术及神经渲染（Neural Rendering）技术，早于《燕云十六声》的 11 月 24 日，并同步支持最高 6 倍插帧，成为真正的全球首批支持该技术的游戏。网易官方表示，DLSS 5 通过 AI 模型参与画面重建，在纹理细节、皮肤次表面散射、接触阴影与头发渲染等方面带来更精细的表现。《永劫无间》服务器原计划于 11 月 5 日早 7:00-12:00 进行停服维护，但截至IT之家发稿仍未开服。据官方介绍，开启 DLSS 5 后，《永劫无间》聚窟洲、蓬莱岛等场景中远景建筑的结构层次、水面反射的连续性与植被纹理的清晰度均有提升，人物近景的皮肤与发丝过渡更为自然。对于 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 系列显卡用户，只需将显卡驱动更新至最新版本，即可在游戏中看到对应选项。据官方介绍，DLSS 5 精简模型运行更快，画面表现相应降低，玩家可根据自身硬件情况选择。如果硬件允许，建议开启标准模型，获得更强的画面表现与体验。《永劫无间》官方表示，本次调整了底层的资源加载机制：将原有的单把粗粒度锁拆解为多把细粒度锁，仅在必要同步点介入，缓解了主线程与后台加载线程经常互相等待的情况。同时，网易还处理了游戏中加载队列的忙等问题，并为并发场景补充了保护逻辑，以降低特定情况下因资源异常引发报错与卡死的风险。这些调整主要针对场景切换、首次打开界面等重度加载环节 —— 整体上有助于让加载过程更顺畅、运行更平稳。相关阅读：《国内首款：网易〈燕云十六声〉官宣 11 月 24 日实装英伟达 DLSS 5》

articles.title: CPU 格局将迎分水岭：AMD 有望史上首次单季营收超越英特尔
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，科技媒体 Tom's Hardware 昨日（11 月 4 日）发布博文，报道称 AMD 官方预估 2026 财年（2025 年 12 月 28 日～2026 年 12 月 26 日）第四财季（2026 年 9 月 26 日～2026 年 12 月 26 日）的营收，有望首次超越英特尔。IT之家查询 AMD 和英特尔官方公布的业绩指引（guidance），AMD 预测第四财季营收约 170 亿美元，同比约增长 66%、环比约增长 27%；而英特尔预估第四财季（2026 年 9 月 26 日～2026 年 12 月 26 日）营收为 150~160 亿美元。该媒体认为该预期若兑现，将成为 x86 芯片行业格局的标志性转折。AMD 的强劲表现主要来自数据中心业务，目前占比已达到 64%。其 EPYC 服务器处理器与 Instinct AI 加速器的需求同比增长接近一倍，成为抵消消费级市场压力的核心动力。随着 AI 训练、推理和云计算需求持续扩张，数据中心芯片正在取代传统 PC 处理器，成为 AMD 最重要的增长引擎。AMD 的盈利能力也因高附加值数据中心产品占比提升而继续改善。不过，AMD 并非全线高歌。受内存价格上涨和行业逆风影响，其面向客户端系统的产品销售额仅小幅下降，但公司预计到 2027 年，客户端和游戏业务可能面临两位数下滑。

articles.title: 奥迪创新技术中心总经理冯思远：AUDI 没有出口海外计划
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，据界面新闻报道，11 月 5 日，在奥迪创新技术中心开业仪式上，奥迪创新技术中心总经理冯思远接受界面新闻等媒体采访时表示，AUDI 品牌车型目前没有出口海外的计划，现阶段目标是将通过一系列产品，进一步开拓中国市场。IT之家注意到，奥迪中国 10 月 26 日宣布，奥迪分别与合作伙伴签署了战略协议，旨在强化奥迪四环品牌与 AUDI (奥迪字母标) 品牌之间的差异化定位及各自的战略侧重，并进一步明确“双品牌、双合作伙伴”渠道架构。根据此前公告，在四环品牌方面，奥迪和中国一汽将持续强化多元且均衡的豪华产品矩阵，涵盖豪华新能源车型以及下一代智能燃油车型，其中包括奥迪 A6L e-tron、Q6L e-tron 以及全新奥迪 A5L、A6L 等。奥迪和上汽集团将进一步深化 AUDI (奥迪字母标) 品牌的发展，致力引领中国豪华智能网联新能源汽车市场。继 2025 年奥迪 E5 Sportback 成功推出后，首款 SUV 奥迪 E7X 已于今年 5 月上市，并取得亮眼的市场关注和用户反响。随着专属 AUDI (奥迪字母标) 品牌的奥迪创新技术中心在上海的正式落成。此外，各项客户服务、售后保障及经销商业务均将继续平稳有序开展。上汽奥迪在 2027 年底前仍可正常销售四环产品。上汽奥迪旗下四环品牌产品以及全新 AUDI (奥迪字母标) 品牌产品的售后服务，均将保持平稳运营。

articles.title: 前 Anthropic Claude Code 产品负责人 Cat Wu 跳槽加入 OpenAI，负责核心产品管理
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，前 Anthropic Claude Code 产品负责人 Cat Wu 今日宣布加入 OpenAI，担任核心产品（Core Products）产品管理负责人。她将参与 OpenAI 核心产品及智能体相关工作，与企业产品负责人 Nick Turley、消费级产品负责人 Ashley Alexander 等人协作，并向 Tibo Sottiaux 汇报。OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 随后也在 X 上转发她的入职消息并表示欢迎。公开报道显示，她此前曾主导 Claude Code 的产品规划与商业化发展，帮助这款最初仅供 Anthropic 内部使用的工具成长为公司的重要商业产品。Cat Wu 表示，她非常尊重 OpenAI，尤其认可该公司将 AI 带给超过 10 亿用户的规模化能力。她期待与 Tibo Sottiaux 及产品团队合作，打造能够帮助个人和团队完成工作的智能体，同时让用户始终保有控制权。《Business Insider》将这次事件称为 OpenAI 的一次重大挖角。报道指出，Cat Wu 曾负责 Claude Code 的产品方向，见证并推动了这款产品从内部原型走向商业化。随着 OpenAI 持续推进 Codex 等产品的发展，她加入核心产品团队也受到外界关注。IT之家注：Cat Wu 为美籍华裔，全名 Catherine Wu，职业经历横跨软件工程、风险投资和产品管理。加入 Anthropic 之前，她曾在 Scale AI、Dagster 等公司从事产品工程工作，之后加入风险投资机构 Index Ventures，担任投资人近三年。2024 年夏天，Cat Wu 加入 Anthropic，最初在研究团队担任产品经理。她曾回忆，自己第一次使用 Claude Code 时，尝试从零搭建一个强化学习环境，经过数十小时的交互引导，最终没有手写一行代码便完成了任务。这次体验促使她转向 Claude Code 项目，成为其早期产品负责人。此后，她与 Claude Code 原创作者 Boris Cherny 形成产品与技术搭档。Boris Cherny 负责最初的原型开发，Cat Wu 则参与产品方向、跨团队协作及商业化工作。Business Insider 报道称，两人共同推动了 Claude Code 在 2025 年末至 2026 年的快速发展。根据 Anthropic 官方公布的数据，截至 2026 年 2 月，Claude Code 的年化收入运行率已经超过 25 亿美元（现汇率约合 167.14 亿元人民币），较 2026 年年初增长一倍以上。同期，该产品的每周活跃用户数量也实现翻倍，企业用户订阅数量较年初增长至原来的 4 倍。除 Claude Code 外，Cat Wu 还参与负责 Anthropic 面向非编程知识工作场景的 Cowork 产品。她曾公开谈及 AI 时代产品经理的工作方式，强调产品经理需要亲自使用 AI 构建原型、设计评测并参与实际开发，而不应只停留在编写产品需求文档（PRD）的阶段。值得注意的是，这并非 Cat Wu 第一次离开 Anthropic。2025 年，她曾与 Boris Cherny 一同前往 AI 编程初创公司 Cursor，随后两人又在约两周后回归 Anthropic。根据 Business Insider 对此前事件的报道，两人回归后继续参与 Claude Code 的产品发展。Cat Wu 上周五刚刚结束了她在 Anthropic 的工作，然后 11 月 5 日紧接着又宣布加入 OpenAI。对于离职是否与员工股份出售安排有关，她在 X 上表示自己并不清楚相关影响，这也不是促使她离职的因素。

articles.title: AI 帮用户“越狱”跑步机：Claude 干掉了 iFIT 订阅墙
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，网友 u/Beloved_Misanthrope 于 11 月 2 日在 Reddit 社区发帖，称其借助 AI 编程工具 Claude Code，成功越狱 NordicTrack Commercial 2250 跑步机，绕开了设备对 iFIT 订阅的强制要求，成功将跑步机的大屏幕改造成可自由使用的流媒体界面。IT之家援引博文介绍，本次 AI 越狱过程在约一天半内完成，相关项目已公开至 GitHub。该网友称其女友几年前购买了这台配备 10 英寸尺寸显示屏的 NordicTrack 跑步机，原本希望在运动时观看 Netflix 或 Crunchyroll。但在实际使用体验中，即便已为流媒体服务付费，设备仍要求额外订阅 iFIT 才能访问相关功能；日常锻炼也需要等待 iFIT 加载，并面对广告与会员提示。该网友为了摆脱订阅墙，使用 Claude Code 改造跑步机系统，改造后设备出现了一个自定义主屏幕，集成 Netflix、Crunchyroll、运动数据和控制选项；用户在观看视频时仍可操作健身功能，实体按键也保持可用。报道还称，Netflix 的启动时间从近一分钟缩短至约 21 秒。不过，这项改造并非没有代价。目前 Netflix 在该设备上最高仅支持标清画质；若执行恢复出厂设置，修改可能被清除。更重要的是，对电动健身设备进行系统改动可能带来安全风险，并影响厂商保修。

articles.title: Omdia 数据：全球平板电脑出货量 2026Q3 同比萎缩 23%，创近三年新低
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，Omdia 英国当地时间今日报告称，全球平板电脑出货量在 2026 年第 3 季度下滑至 3,200 万台，创下近三年来的单季新低，同比则大幅萎缩 23%。其中，中东、中国、西欧市场受到的冲击最为严重。▲ 图源：OmdiaOmdia 研究经理 Himani Mukka 表示：继上季度下滑 10% 之后，平板电脑市场在第三季度再次出现两位数萎缩。随着供应限制加剧，平板电脑在厂商 2026 年和 2027 年的战略重点中地位日益下降。预计明年供应状况将进一步收紧，平板电脑市场在 2028 年之前不太可能出现实质性复苏。▲ 图源：Omdia值得注意的是，在友商普遍遭遇逆风的同时，联想再次实现了逆势强劲增长，市场占有率进一步提升。参考Omdia: Global tablet shipments fall 23% to 32 million in Q3 2026

articles.title: AI 抢走产能，任天堂实体游戏卡带供应链告急
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，科技媒体 Ars Technica 昨日（11 月 4 日）发布博文，报道称由于 AI 抢走产能，任天堂实体游戏卡带的核心零部件正遭遇罕见供应压力。任天堂实体卡带的主要 ROM 存储芯片供应商旺宏电子（Macronix）第三季度（2026 年 7 月 1 日至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）财报中，其 ROM 芯片生产“已告一段落”，并将逐步退出游戏产业。旺宏电子称，过去一年其 ROM 芯片产量下降约 39%，目前仅占公司业务的 5%；相比之下，NOR 闪存、NAND 闪存和 eMMC 等芯片利润更高、需求更旺，正在挤占 ROM 芯片的晶圆产能。IT之家附上相关截图如下：图源：旺宏电子财报分析师 David Gibson 指出，旺宏电子一直是任天堂实体游戏卡带的“主要存储芯片供应商”。在旺宏逐步退出后，任天堂可能需要更多依赖罗姆半导体（Rohm）和蓝碧石半导体（Lapis Semiconductor）等供应商，卡带生产成本存在上升风险。该媒体解读认为这并不意味着任天堂将立即放弃实体游戏。任天堂上月表示，近期没有取消游戏卡带的计划；但若生产成本继续走高，发行商可能进一步上调实体版价格，或更多采用容量较小、成本更低的卡带方案。

articles.title: Kimi Hosted Agents 托管智能体发布，将 Harness 作为云端服务提供
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 5 日消息，Kimi 今日宣布推出 Kimi Hosted Agents（托管智能体），将支撑 Agent 运行的 Harness 作为云端服务提供（Harness as a Service）。企业和开发者无需自行搭建和维护运行框架，即可获得 7×24 小时的托管环境，支持长程任务执行与多智能体高效协作。企业可以按需配置 Agent，快速构建两类业务应用：面向内部业务：集成到企业内部系统，提供业务监控、运维响应等任务。面向产品用户：嵌入企业对外提供的产品，提供 App 内的投研助手、客服助手等 Agent 服务。为保障 Agent 安全可控地运行，Kimi Hosted Agents 提供独立沙箱、网络访问权限控制，企业可设定操作边界，并在必要时随时中止会话；执行过程留痕可查，支持审计导出；清晰的计费规则与用量报表，也让企业能够掌握各个 Agent 项目资源消耗与费用。Kimi 官方表示，依托 Kimi Hosted Agents 提供的 Harness 框架与托管环境，企业可以快速定义任务、接入工具，缩短从原型验证到应用上线的开发周期。底层运行环境的维护与升级由 Kimi 负责，团队无需反复投入基础设施适配与运维，可以更快响应业务需求、迭代应用功能。Kimi Hosted Agents 目前提供 140+ Skills 与 30+ 插件，覆盖联网检索、专业数据查询、办公文档处理和内容生成等任务，开发者可按需调用，减少逐项接入工具的开发工作。企业也可接入自有工具和数据源，让智能体适配具体业务流程。Kimi Hosted Agents 可结合开放平台的独立安全组件 Kimi Inference Hook，对接企业自建或采购的安全服务，在每次模型推理前检查任务输入与工具返回内容，将隐私和敏感数据拦截在推理之前。安全检查规则由企业定义，放行或拒绝由 Kimi Inference Hook 执行：只有通过企业安全检查的内容才会进入模型推理。Kimi 开放平台文档站同步提供配套的 Agent 架构设计思路、配置教程、运行成本估算；企业可将 Agent 模板复制到自己的项目空间，接入内部业务系统、私有数据库等资源，按需调整任务流程，快速构建适合自身业务的智能体。首批提供 8 个金融 Agent 模板，覆盖投研建模、深度研究、晨报生成、IPO 跟踪、持仓监控等任务，支持在托管环境中持续运行。企业可以将 Agent 模板复制到自己的项目空间，接入内部研报、私有数据库等资源，适配实际业务流程。IT之家附 Kimi Hosted Agents 定价如下：总费用 = 沙箱运行时长（小时）× ¥0.072 / 小时 + 模型推理费用 + Σ（插件调用次数 x 插件单价）

articles.title: 0.016% 的 Astra 微创手术，治好了 Qwen 的 3 万 Token 死循环
articles.content: 当「读懂权重」和「改写权重」被同一个模型打通，「AI 改进 AI」就多了一条不经过梯度下降的短路通道，模型维护与模型能力放大之间的边界开始模糊。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       一个模型做数学题，写了 3 万多个 Token，仍然在重复相似的推理过程，最后连答案也交不出来。碰到这种情况，通常会调整训练数据、优化推理策略，或者重新微调模型。但 MIT CSAIL 最近尝试了一种更直接的办法：让 GPT-6 Astra 检查 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的内部权重，找出问题发生的位置，再直接修改参数。结果，Astra 只改动了约 0.016% 的权重，就让 Qwen 的 MATH-500 成绩从 7.9% 提升到 48.1%，接近原来的 6 倍。这项研究真正的信号，不是“0.016% 权重换 6 倍成绩”这个数字，而是它把机制可解释性的输出从“解释”变成了“可执行的编辑指令”，让AI有了改造另一个AI的“抓手”。更有意思的是，同一组实验中，Astra 还能只看参数认出神经网络学过什么游戏、哪种语言，甚至从零写出一套网络权重，让它直接学会玩游戏。研究者把这种能力称为 Weight-Space Programming，即权重空间编程。它背后有一个很有意思的技术变化：当神经网络里的参数能够被还原成具体的计算过程，LLM 就有机会像修改代码一样，直接改写模型内部的功能。这件事如何实现，要从 Astra 阅读权重的方式说起。01只给一堆数字，Astra 怎么知道网络学会了什么？研究者先做了一个猜游戏的实验。他们分别训练了 4 个神经网络，让它们学会 Breakout、Pong、Pac-Man 和 Freeway。为了避免通过网络大小猜答案，4 个模型采用完全相同的架构，每个包含 17253 个参数，输入都是 10×10 的游戏网格，输出对应 5 种动作。雷峰网训练结束后，研究者只把权重交给 Astra，不告诉游戏名称，也不允许运行网络。Astra 却认出了全部 4 款游戏。它利用的是训练留在参数里的痕迹。例如 Breakout 的球拍始终沿屏幕底部移动，网络输入层中负责读取玩家位置的权重，就会集中在网格下沿。再结合输出层对左右动作的响应，Astra 便能判断网络正在控制什么。不过，游戏网络有一个便利条件：输入位置有明确的物理含义。大型语言模型的隐藏维度没有这样的标签，某个参数很大，并不能直接说明它代表什么。为了检验 Astra 能否理解更复杂的结构，研究者训练了 3 个约 720 万参数的字符级 Transformer，分别学习 Python、罗马字日语和英语。随后移除输入 Embedding 和输出层，只留下中间的 4 个 Transformer Block。这样一来，Astra 无法知道隐藏维度对应哪些字符，也不能运行模型观察输出，只能分析内部矩阵之间的关系。它找到的突破口是 Induction Head，也就是 Transformer 中帮助模型复制历史文本的一类 Attention Head。例如，前文已经出现过 total，后文再次出现 tot，模型可以找到之前相同的片段，接着生成 al。这个操作看似简单，内部却需要完成两件事：先定位历史中的重复片段，再把它后面的字符信息带到当前位置。在 Transformer 中，QK 电路负责决定读取历史中的哪个位置，OV 电路负责决定读取的信息怎样写回隐藏状态。而一次完整的复制操作，往往需要不同 Attention Head 配合：前面的 Head 提供字符位置关系，后面的 Head 利用这些信息寻找匹配片段。Astra 沿着信息传递路径分析不同 Head 的矩阵乘积，寻找能够完成这种配合的结构。结果，它在 Python 模型中找到了 3 个 copying head，在另外两个模型中各找到 1 个，随后通过实际运行网络得

articles.title: 当10万个智能体已在运行，安全防线到底在哪？｜CNCC 2026专家激辩智能体安全挑战
articles.content: 2026年，智能体从概念走向了生产系统。蚂蚁集团3万多名员工背后，已有10万余个智能体在运行。华为内部同样部署了成千上万个智能体，覆盖客服、办公、运维、研发各条业务线。放眼更广的产业图景，个人助手、AI for Science、网络安全自动化攻防、企业级工作流编排，智能体正在逐步接管人类过去亲力亲为的工作。Gartner将智能体列入了2027年十大战略技术，安全圈里，非人类身份（NHI）成了RSAC大会上的新赛道。中国这边，国标、强标、最高法司法意见、三部委规范文件在今年密集出台，政策端的紧迫感与产业端的狂飙几乎同步。10月22日，成都，在CNCC 2026”智能体的安全问题”专题论坛上，于锐、徐恪、胡侠、韦韬、肖亚军五位嘉宾齐聚一堂，分别从国家标准制定、高校AI安全研究、企业安全最后一道防线等角度，做出了各自的解读。01 中国开始给智能体发“身份证”安全的第一步是搞清楚“它是谁”。但智能体能自主行动、跨平台迁移、在无人监督下链式决策和调用工具，传统的人类身份认证方式显然并不适用。CCF计算机安全专委会副主任委员于锐介绍，“中国在这方面的进展可以概括为三句话：国标引领、行业细化、企业落地。”今年5月出台的GB/T 185系列标准覆盖了智能体安全治理的全生命周期，两个核心要求是授予每个智能体唯一的身份标识，以及实施统一的身份管理。编码方式采用OID，树形分层结构，一码一主体，永不重复。“跟我们人一样，也给智能体发了一个身份号码。”于锐表示。另一个正在制定的强制性标准是《智能体应用安全基本条件》，该标准一旦发布，没有身份和标识的智能体将无法上线应用。而身份只是最表层的一环，于锐将智能体的身份拆为三层：第一层是产品身份，包含智能体的ID、代码指纹和版本号，用于回答“这是哪个智能体”；第二层是运行时身份，校验其运行环境、设备信息和调用来源，反映“它此刻在做什么”；第三层是责任主体，通过实名认证和企业认定，解决的是“出了事找谁”。“不是授一次权就让它一直做下去，按任务给最低授权，任务完成就收回权限。”于锐强调。技术实现层面，认证走OAuth/OIDC，授权走OAuth，凭证参考JWT格式。但无论走哪条技术路线，最终都绕不开一个关键问题：信任的锚点。关于这一点，于锐介绍了他们正在建设的国家网络可信身份公共服务平台。国标的OID、W3C的DID、IETF基于DNS的方案，信任锚点都落在实名认证上。“这个国家平台是新型数字基础设施，主要是给公民签发线上的网号网证，就是你线上的身份标识和可验证凭证。”于锐介绍，平台的实施管理办法今年7月正式发布，目前已达到每秒15万次的服务能力，接入了900多个机构，下载申领量突破6000万。“目的就是形成一个数字空间的信任根，来支撑国标185的落地。”身份解决了“智能体是谁”的问题，但在责任归属上，由于智能体不是人，没有法律资格无法自己承担责任，这一点国内外并无分歧。对此，今年9月，最高人民法院发布了《关于审理涉人工智能纠纷案件的意见》，按控制力、场景和获利划分责任：一般场景适用过错责任，开发者和使用者承担风控告知和复核义务；具身智能场景适用产品责任，机器人造成伤害，制造商承担无过错责任；涉及个人信息的场景实行过错推定，由运营方自证合规。02 旧安全架构无法抵挡新攻击标准和法规在加速推进，但技术侧的问题更为棘手。“中文里‘安全’是两个字，英文里是safety、security、reliability、privacy、stability、trustworthiness，无数概念混在其中。AI这一轮爆发之后，攻防天平已经严重失衡。”对于智能体安全问题现状，蚂蚁集团副总裁兼首席技术安全官、蚂蚁密算科技有限公司董事长韦韬感慨道。韦韬透露，就在大会前两天，一家知名的数据库公司全面爆雷，紧随其后，PHP和NodeJS接连曝出高危漏洞。“大模型领域广泛使用的LiteLLM网关被投毒，攻击者在全面利用AI提升攻击效率。”防守方的处境则更加被动，AI编程导致代码产出速度暴涨，许多公司一个月的漏洞产出量已经相当于过去一年，修复速度始终无法跟上。“大家非常熟悉的DAC、MAC、贝尔-拉帕杜拉这些访问控制模型，是在六七十年代主机时代起来的，在局域网时代完善的。到了云时代，整个链条持续扩大，主体爆炸、客体爆炸、链条爆炸，访问控制模型已经严重失衡了。”韦韬指出，AI攻击能力的爆发式提升让各家的欠债集中暴露。与此同时，智能体带来的不只是旧问题的放大，还有全新的结构性隐患。韦韬将矛头指向了更底层的根源：自然语言本身就不适合作为安全载体。“今天大家造智能体的习惯是自然语言加Guardrails，智能部分靠自然语言，过程部分靠Guardrails。但自然语言是一个非常糟糕的载体，含混，条件描述讲不清楚，逻辑控制的边界也讲不清楚，表达里到处是go

articles.title: 90 后北大副教授董豪：启元机器人，正在勇闯具身终局
articles.content: 做具身，不能一上来什么都干，也不能什么都不干。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       董豪是具身行业里一个十足的非典型选手。大多数人对他的印象，停在 29 岁便是北大博导的年轻学者身份，以及最近任职启元机器人首席科学家、带队攻坚家用具身智能的产业标签。但很少有人知道，他读博之前曾有过一段三年创业最终折戟的经历，住过工厂的八人间宿舍；更少有人知道，智元刚创立时，他就是最早加入、陪着初创团队闯过无数关口的核心成员之一。当行业还在热议大模型、通用机器人的宏大叙事时，他盯着的是另一个一点都不性感的真问题：靠上万台真机做后训练，成本高到难以落地，这条路要怎么破？他最近给出的答案是三个关键词：HIL-UMI、Scaling Law 和量产。而这份答案的底层逻辑，早就写进了他一路 “压缩着走” 的人生里。硕士毕业，他婉拒了导师的直接读博的建议，回国创办公司做可穿戴设备与脑机接口，一头扎进工厂，住过八人间宿舍。三年后亲眼见证市场被大厂快速挤压，他没有恋战，转身回到帝国理工攻读博士，四年后顺利毕业，期间主导开发的开源框架，还斩获了 ACM MM 最佳开源软件奖。 毕业后，他加入北京大学入职不久就撞上疫情，对着全程不开摄像头的学生，线上讲了一整年的机器人课。2023 年智元机器人创立，他作为核心成员加入，成立北大智元联合实验室；如今他转身出任启元首席科学家，一头扎进了难度最高的 ToC 具身智能赛道。在行业里，董豪向来朋友众多，创业经历、顶尖学术、头部产业的履历，也带着一种罕见的跨界流动感。一个完整亲历过硬科技公司从起盘到落幕全过程的人，又转身沉潜到学术浓度极高的北京大学，如今再站到产业最前沿，他会怎么看当下的具身智能行业？ 带着这个问题，我们在北大校园里见到了董豪。以下是访谈内容，《AI 科技评论》在不改变原意的基础上做了编辑。01一个"压缩着走"的人▎AI科技评论：你英本英硕四年读完，29岁北大博导。这个节奏在学术圈压缩了三五年。你自己意识到吗？董豪：没刻意算过。英本英硕那个体系本来就快，四年硕士毕业是正常操作。▎AI科技评论：但不到30岁入职北大不正常，你拿到教职第一年还撞上疫情。董豪：第一次上课是线上，学生不开摄像头，不吱声，我全程自己讲，有时候问问有没有问题，没人回。搞机器人的全线上，机器人摸不到。最惨的是突然解封能用一下，突然又封了，断断续续。很多人没熬过去，我运气还不错。▎AI科技评论：只归给运气？董豪：还有就是我做的事聚焦。机器人这个方向，学术和产业都关注，两头都不浪费。▎AI科技评论：“两头都不浪费”，这个说法很像你。你好像天生不喜欢单维度做事。董豪：可能吧。比如你提到我以前做的AI框架，当时本来是实验室内部工具，放着可惜就开源了，结果用户越来越多，还拿了奖。一个工作，长出好几个东西，效率高。02一位90后北大副教授的创业往事▎AI科技评论：2012 年硕士毕业，导师郭毅可（中国工程院外籍院士、现港科大首席副校长）劝你读博，你没听，回国创业，具体是什么情况。董豪：研究生跟着郭老师做科研，郭老师让直接读博，结果我决定回国创业，他支持我，还给了钱，后来 2015 年回去读博，他也没说什么，给了我很大自由，让我自己选课题。▎AI科技评论：创业做可穿戴设备？董豪：是的，当时势头很猛。创业的时候住工厂，条件很差，都是八人间，我待遇好一点，一个人住一个八人间，八个床，想睡哪个睡哪个。▎AI科技评论：那三年应该挺苦的。董豪：苦倒不至于，就是看得见一个创业团队完整的命。可穿戴设备：便携脑机接口、智能手环，我们先做的，前者是面向未来、后者面向当下。小米华为后来入局可穿戴，但人家一做起来非常快。眼睁睁看着市场没了。▎AI科技评论：硬科技创业最难的是什么？董豪：量产。样机半年就能做出来，但你要造一百个产品，成本要控制住，良品率要高，还得耐用，这个要花一两年。一个小改

articles.title: 产业资本继续押注具身：斯坦福双子星创办的黑马公司 RoboScience 机器科学，宣布完成 A2 轮融资
articles.content: 具身智能的资本筛选标准，正在从"讲得动人"转向"兑现得动"。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       AI 科技评论获悉，11 月 2 日，RoboScience 机器科学完成 A2 轮融资。据悉，本轮由琥珀资本、鸿瑞达投资、上海半导体产投 联合领投，360 战投、爽资本、国联民生资本、金鼎资本及多家上市公司平台跟投，融资金额达到了数亿元。这意味着，这家 2025 年 3 月才正式开始运营的具身公司，先后已完成五轮融资。据 AI 科技评论了解，近期具身行业融资市场并不乐观。过去一年，这个赛道的融资叙事换了好几轮：最早讲世界模型就能拿到钱；后来光讲技术不够了，得讲落地，讲进工厂的 ROI ；再后来，得有"具身 RSI "（递归自我改进）的想象空间。故事通胀的背后，是大多数团队的底子撑不起叙事的升级，每次风口转向，就得重新攒一套说辞。资本也随之变得挑剔，同样的 BP，去年能融到，今年连会都约不上。（雷峰网）但 RoboScience 机器科学的节奏完全不同，逆势不断受到资本青睐，也因此成为具身领域里一个值得研究的样本公司。回看机器科学过去五轮融资的时间点，几乎每一轮前后，都有可验证的产品技术落地：ICRA 最佳论文、仿真平台 RoboMirage、通用具身大模型 Visics、与腾讯云共创的云端具身智能服务 EaaS、首款轮式仿人形通用机器人 REX G1 以及真实的项目落地。某种意义上，这意味着，具身市场的融资，不该是技术跟着融资的故事走，反过来，融资应该跟着技术的兑现走。在 AI 科技评论看来，这是本轮融资最值得关注的信号：具身智能的资本筛选标准，正在从"讲得动人"转向"兑现得动"。一家公司的融资节奏如果能与技术节奏对齐，说明它手里握着可以持续拿出来的东西。在 AI 科技评论看来，这跟创始人团队有着分不开的关系。01斯坦福双子星，如何撑起一家中国具身头部公司在中国具身行业，从占据头部公司的创始人学术履历已经能看出几条清晰的派系：清华系、伯克利圈、斯坦福圈等等。其中影响最深的，是斯坦福圈。银河通用王鹤、穹彻智能卢策吾、Hillbot 苏昊，RoboScience 机器科学的（）这些公司和创始人路线各不相同，但往上追，大多能追到同一个实验室，美国三院院士、几何计算学者 Leonidas J. Guibas 在斯坦福的组。同一条脉络上还有 OpenAI 研究员严梦媛、清华大学助理教授弋力。这不算偶然。斯坦福几乎是全球具身智能研究的策源地之一：李飞飞，作为 ImageNet 发起人，视觉与数据驱动范式的奠基者，Chelsea Finn 的 REAL Lab ，以及几何计算学者 Leonidas J. Guibas，以及国外头部具身公司 Pi 创始成员都来自斯坦福。2016 年前后，斯坦福 Leonidas J. Guibas 教授（美国三院院士 ）的几何计算组，聚集了一批华人学生，其中就包括王鹤、邵林和他们的师兄苏昊等。Guibas 教授组有一条相当一致的研究主线：3D 视觉出身，重点钻研操作泛化，相信抽象表征和仿真。邵林的个人轨迹几乎是这条主线的完整样本。2014 年邵林进斯坦福，他先在几何计算泰斗、美国三院院士 Leonidas J. Guibas 组里做 3D 视觉，后转向机器人操作，师从 Jeannette Bohg，现任新加坡国立大学助理教授。学术方面，邵林的一作论文 UniGrasp 是数据驱动灵巧手抓取的基准性工作；2025 年，团队凭借 D(R,O) Grasp 从四千多篇投稿中斩获 ICRA 机器人操作与运动方向最佳论文奖，成为近五年亚洲机构首次以第一单位身份拿下这一奖项的团队，打破了欧美的长期垄断；2026 年，Bi-Adapt 再度入围该奖

articles.content: GPT-6之后，机器人公司还有价值吗？智元用2万台出货量背后的“Worken”算力账本回应。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       2026年，具身智能赛道正在陷入一场前所未有的情绪焦虑。GPT-6 Astra展示出的具身控制能力，让"物理AI即将被AI击穿"的论调甚嚣尘上；负责感知与决策的S2层，正在以肉眼可见的速度被通用智能接管。行业里甚至出现了明确的路线分化：一批做模型的公司开始转型卖数据，"卖铲子"成了新的安全区。而在烈火烹油的显示场景中，哪怕今年中国机器人整机产量突破10万台，能真正在流水线上替代现实工作、替人类扛起KPI的确寥寥无几。所有从业者都在等一个答案：当通用大模型不断吞噬智能的上层，做机器人的公司，价值锚点到底在哪里？10月29日，上海世博中心，智元创新日（A.I. DAY），稚晖君、姚卯青、熊彦、王闯和他们的智元军团用两个多小时的发布会，给出了一套完整的回应。现场超1000名科研伙伴、开发者、商业伙伴与媒体参会，线上超50家媒体直播。AI科技评论认为，这场分享里，有非常多的干货和行业痛点，值得跟大家剖析：01Worken：稚晖现场造了一个具身新名词发布会开场，稚晖君先泼了一盆冷水。“中国今年机器人整机产量预计突破10万台，但我们也必须清醒：生产了多少台机器人，并不等于真实世界就多了多少生产力。”这句话说完，现场一片沉默。这也是AI科技评论在一些行业调研中发现的“行业幻觉”：量产的新闻满天飞，但真正持续投入生产力的寥寥无几。对此，智元给出的解法是一个全新的度量衡：Worken（有效智能工时）：Worken = 活跃机器人数量 × 自主工作时长 × 产出效能比三个乘数，各自藏着具身行业的三个痛点问题：宕机、离线、维护中的机器不算活跃；遥操作时段不计入自主工作时长。镜头前忙得团团转、镜头后站着三个手柄操作员的机器人，在这套算法下工时直接清零；产出效能比以一个标准工人的单位时间合格产出为1.0，干得比人慢就不达标。为解释这个概念，稚晖君串起了一段度量衡史：蒸汽时代看"马力"，电力时代看"千瓦时"，数字AI时代则是用"Token"度量思考量。他总结道：“token衡量机器思考了多少，Worken衡量机器行动了多少。”在AI科技评论看来，这个概念的提出，远比发布某个产品重要，它代表着资深从业者对这个行业的深度思考。大模型产业之所以能形成今天按量计费、按效果定价的商业闭环，token居功至伟。它让"智能"首次成为可定价交易的商品。而物理AI行业苦无度量衡久矣：买卖双方无法定价，资本算不清楚投入产出，Worken正是解开这个死结的关键。稚晖君没有仅仅停留在造新词上，现场他直接切出了实时工时看板：龙旗产线的上下料机器人、香格里拉酒店的服务机器人、长隆乐园的文旅机器人，每台机器当月贡献的有效工时实时滚动。他调侃了道：“上过班的朋友都填过工时，未来对机器人的服务，也要按Worken来计费。”同场，由中国信通院等权威机构联合编制的《2026具身智能产业创新报告》正式发布，Worken及相关部署态实例成功入选。度量衡刚发布，就已经有了权威背书。在AI科技评论看来，“从卖机器人到卖工时”，是理解智元全部商业逻辑的钥匙。当机器人按Worken计费，客户买的就不再是一台出厂即巅峰、逐年折旧的设备，而是一个持续进化的生产力单元。稚晖君的另一句话点明了资产属性的变化：“硬件会陈旧，但智能可以升值。”02六个月前出的题，这次交卷了对Worken的构思最早源于六个月前的APC2026智元合作伙伴大会。当时，智元创始人邓泰华断言：2026年是具身智能从"开发态"迈入"部署态"的元年。稚晖君则定调：“行业真正的分水岭，是从’卖

articles.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
articles.content: WIRED uncovered some 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that look like regular AI tools but had secret features that let users create violent AI-generated images and video.
